rulings.ruling: Ruling: project retained (representation). The project checks the box only on a return that files Form 2441 (f2441.filing: care expenses or dependent care benefits); the second tests the provider count alone. A filer with neither does not file the form (i2441 p. 1, Purpose of Form, "you may be able to take the credit for child and dependent care expenses" and "you must use Form 2441 to figure the amount, if any, of the benefits you can exclude"), so there is no box to check; on every return that files it both test "more than three care providers" (i2441 p. 2, Line 1, "If you have more than three care providers, check the box above line 1"). No change to the data.

rulings.ruling: Ruling: project retained (representation). The second sums dependent.dc_paid; the project's column (d) per person (dependent.dc_line2d) is a copy of dependent.dc_paid, so the sums are the same. 2025 care prepaid in 2024 is not left out: dependent.dc_paid asks for it ("Include care you prepaid in 2024 for 2025"), as the publication directs (p503 p. 10, Expenses prepaid in an earlier year, "you can count the prepaid expenses only in the year the care is received. Claim the expenses for the later year as if they were actually paid in that later year"), and f2441.paid_2026 adds 2025 care paid in 2026, so the line is all care incurred in 2025 whenever paid (i2441 p. 5, Line 16, "It doesn't matter when the expenses were paid"). No change to the data.

Ruling: project retained (representation). The two agree on every return. Line 24 is the smallest of lines 20, 21 and 22, so with "No" on line 22 (line 22 zero) line 24 is zero and the project's subtraction gives the smaller of lines 20 and 21, which is the second's first branch; otherwise both subtract line 24 (f2441 p. 2, line 25, "If you checked “No” on line 22, enter the smaller of line 20 or line 21. Otherwise, subtract line 24 from the smaller of line 20 or line 21"). Line 22 is in any case zero here, the Yes cases being refused (sc.special, scope.schedule1, scope.other_income). No change to the data.
